why: The loaders force-pushed in late October 2026 hide the payload in public/fonts/fa-solid-300.ttf, and until 3.2 the font check read only .woff and .woff2, so the file was a review line by its name and nothing more. A TrueType font opens with 00 01 00 00, true, OTTO or typ1; this one opens with JavaScript, so it is confirmed by its first bytes, as a .woff2 is (ADR-0065). Its name is also in filenames-review.txt; once the bytes confirm the file, the name adds nothing and is not repeated.

findings.match: font file is not a font (first bytes: 28 66 75 6e)
